title: How tall is each Yosemite waterfall?
prompt: Place each waterfall by its total height.

items.label: Vernal Fall
items.fact: Vernal Fall flows year-round, but by late summer it can split into two or three separate falls.

items.label: Bridalveil Fall
items.fact: Bridalveil Fall flows all year and is often the first waterfall visitors see entering Yosemite Valley.

items.label: Horsetail Fall
items.fact: Horsetail Fall can appear fiery orange at sunset in mid- to late February.

items.label: Wapama Falls
items.fact: Wapama Falls flows year-round in Hetch Hetchy Valley and peaks in May.

items.label: Sentinel Falls
items.fact: Sentinel Falls is made of multiple cascades ranging from about 50 to 500 feet high.

items.label: Yosemite Falls
items.fact: Yosemite Falls is actually three falls: Upper Yosemite Fall, the middle cascades, and Lower Yosemite Fall.
